title: Knowledge
description: Manage Agent retrieval knowledge, ingest status, and visibility
uploadHint: Files upload to controlled storage and are indexed after ingest.
updateHint: Save metadata, replace the file, or adjust advanced chunking. Re-indexing runs automatically when needed.
replaceTextHint: Provide the full new body. Saving re-chunks, re-vectorizes, and replaces previous content.
fileNameHint: Extension selects the reader and chunking strategy

ingest.strategyHint: Overrides extension inference; keep automatic in most cases.
ingest.chunkSizeHint: Target/max chunk length; smaller is more precise, larger keeps more context.
ingest.chunkOverlapHint: Shared characters between chunks; improves continuity but grows the index.
ingest.headingsHint: Split on heading levels; e.g. H1-H2 keeps H3+ under their H2.
ingest.codeChunkHint: Max code chunk length; too small may split functions, too large coarsens retrieval.
ingest.codeTokenizerHint: Code length estimate; character is stable, gpt2 is closer to tokens.
ingest.astHint: Keep AST node info in code chunks for debugging or finer structure.
ingest.skipHeaderHint: Skip the first header row when it contains field names.
ingest.cleanWhitespaceHint: Normalize whitespace in rows; keep enabled in most cases.
ingest.semanticThresholdHint: Semantic similarity threshold; lower splits more, higher merges more.
ingest.semanticWindowHint: Sentence window when comparing semantic change; larger is smoother.
ingest.minSentenceLenHint: Sentences shorter than this are not used as stable split points.

dragUpload: Drag a document here, or click to select
uploadSupport: Markdown, text, code, CSV, JSON, PDF, and DOCX up to 50 MB
dragReplace: Drag a new document here, or click to select
replaceSupport: Leave empty to keep the current file; supports Markdown, text, code, CSV, JSON, PDF, and DOCX.
selectDocMeta: Select a document to view metadata

errors.tooLarge: File must be 50 MB or smaller
errors.unsupported: This file type is not supported

profiles.semantic: Split plain text by semantic boundaries
profiles.json: Read JSON structure then split recursively

searchFailed: Knowledge search failed. Please try again.
noRetrievalHits: No hits above the similarity threshold (empty results allowed)
retrievalThresholdHint: Threshold {{threshold}}; chunks below it are not injected into chat.
